learning_outcomes.text: Students expand their knowledge of the fundamental concepts and techniques of simulation. They learn various model types and validation methods to analyze and understand complex systems. Furthermore, they become familiar with current developments such as virtual product development, Virtual Reality, and sustainability aspects. Through practical exercises and applications in various fields, they gain valuable experience for their professional future.

Students have a profound understanding of the fundamental concepts, methods, and applications in simulation technology. They are able to distinguish different model types, create and validate models, and perform simulations of continuous and discrete systems. Furthermore, they understand the importance of virtual product development, Virtual Reality, and sustainability aspects in the context of simulation technology.

Students can apply and transfer their acquired knowledge and skills in various areas. They are able to analyze complex systems, develop models, and perform simulations to address real-world problems. Their understanding of virtual product development, Virtual Reality, and sustainability aspects enables them to develop innovative solutions and collaborate effectively with interdisciplinary teams.

syllabus_topics: Integration methods for ordinary differential equations
Integration methods for partial differential equations
Various laboratory exercises complement and deepen the lecture material
assessment_rules: The graded examination is an oral examination or a written exam, chosen by the lecturer. The ungraded examination is experimental work, consisting of approximately 5 experiments, each lasting 90 minutes. Specific durations for oral and written exams are subject to the general examination regulations and the valid study regulations, respectively.
